parameters.name: ClientIpTag
parameters.description: The header used to obtain the client IP address. If you use the default header, leave this parameter empty. If you use a custom header, set this parameter to the header name. You can specify up to five header names. Separate them with commas (,).

parameters.name: DefenseStatus
parameters.description:
The protection status. Valid values: \`on\`, \`off\`, or empty.

- **on**: Enables protection for the domain names. The \`ClientIpTag\` parameter takes effect. If you use the default header, \`ClientIpTag\` is empty. If you use a custom header, \`ClientIpTag\` is set to the specified value.

- **off**: Disables protection for the domain names. The \`ClientIpTag\` parameter does not take effect.

- empty: Leave this parameter empty if you only want to modify the \`ClientIpTag\` parameter.

parameters.name: DomainNames
parameters.description: The domain names for which you want to change the protection status. You can specify up to 50 domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).
